in_hebrew.name: Gonta
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gonta הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Gonos', meaning 'Strong' or 'Worker'. This name has been borne by several saints and early Christian figures.

in_greek.name: Gonta
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong, Worker
in_greek.long_meaning: Gonta είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'Gonos', meaning 'Strong' or 'Worker'. This name has been borne by several saints and early Christian figures.

in_latin.name: Gonta
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong, Worker
in_latin.long_meaning: Gonta est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'Gonos', meaning 'Strong' or 'Worker'. This name has been borne by several saints and early Christian figures.
